findings.authorDisposition: C04 registration remains opaque; this proposal limits comparison to S3 structures, epoch equality, D three purpose/role pairs, D/K refs and supplied bytes. Registration parser/schema/trust digest construction and actual authority require HD-1 plus separate exact decision.
R/N original SHA preserved in M merge; both develop push CI verified. Historical R-not-merged wording in N retained.

review.prCiCorrection: N PR docs-only Fast Gate had skipped build/smoke/UI steps despite workflow success; not all steps actually ran. This does not alter the pasted report bytes.

requestedImplementationFiles.responsibility: CJSON encode/strict canonical decode, raw/domain SHA; no new protocol fields
Only BlobRef/GitFileRef/SignaturePayload/SignatureReceipt/TrustAnchor structural decoder; not all S3/S4/D records
PureEd25519 verification/framing/receipt digest for the three D purposes; no operational signer or authority
Structure and explicit equality/obvious incompatibility only; no registration parser, digest construction, epoch authority or Git resolver
All subset cases using public vectors and, only after separate approval, volatile synthetic key/signature
Public synthetic wire/golden data only; no operational key/receipt/holdout content

scalarAndWireRules.trustEpoch: opaque NFC ASCII equality only; no invented issuance/ordering schema
scalarAndWireRules.utc: real calendar UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ; operational boundary policy deferred
scalarAndWireRules.path: relative POSIX, nonempty segments, no drive/backslash/dot/dotdot; actual Git mode not checked
scalarAndWireRules.base64: standard padded decode/re-encode equality, no noncanonical pad bits; publicKey=32 and signature=64 bytes
scalarAndWireRules.previousEpochDigest: nullable for first-epoch structure only; first-epoch truth/chain not established
scalarAndWireRules.registrationReceipt: opaque BlobRef; optional supplied bytes compared only
scalarAndWireRules.trustPolicyDigest: explicit comparison input only, never added to TrustAnchor wire; no construction formula
scalarAndWireRules.canonical: S1 mem-cjson-1; no NFC normalization, duplicate-key loss, unsafe integers or non-scalar UTF8

componentResultProposal.scopeLimits: C04 expected facts are test/comparison input, never a registration schema. No callback that supplies purported trust authority.
